description: Official Kling AI Global hosted MCP for image and video generation, reference-image workflows, reusable Elements, motion control and task tracking. OAuth uses a Global-region Kling account; generation consumes that account's credits. Global and China accounts and credits are separate.

notes: OAuth with a Global-region Kling account; generation uses account credits.

clients: and MCP clients that support Streamable HTTP and OAuth. See the package page for the npm plugin's supported local assistants.
